Art & identity.

Raphael · The School of Athens, 1509–1511

Fresco, Stanza della Segnatura, Vatican. The Wikimedia Commons Featured Picture documents the artwork. The Vatican source was stitched by FranksValli; the current file was uploaded by Paul 012. Commons marks it as a public-domain reproduction (PD-Art, Public Domain Mark 1.0). Accessed 12 November 2026. This site uses the Vatican Museums reproduction. Reproduction used for its connection to discussion and learning, not as a depiction of the academy.

Vatican Museums artwork page ↗

Jean Honoré Fragonard · Young Girl Reading, c. 1769

National Gallery of Art, Washington. Gift of Mrs. Mellon Bruce in memory of her father, Andrew W. Mellon. Image supplied through the museum’s public-domain Open Access collection. Wikimedia Commons reference credits the National Gallery of Art as the source and Crisco 1492 as the current uploader. Commons marks it as a public-domain reproduction (PD-Art, Public Domain Mark 1.0). Accessed 12 November 2026.
